summary: Independent G3 English review of EFMP-302 Unit 3 against the frozen bundle at commit ac13c5c. The prepared manifest was re-derived and matched exactly (108 paths, 0 digest differences, matching skill digest). All six mandatory deterministic gates pass and the unit's scholarship discipline is unusually strong: three of seven sources were verified against full text or abstract and state exactly what the prose claims, and Topic 3.4 explicitly refuses both the 93% non-verbal myth and its usual replacement. Coverage, authority, readability and pedagogy are satisfied. Three criteria are not. `sources`: the coverage matrix grounds U3-08 (conflict management) in goe2008, whose full text contains no conflict-management passage, and Topic 3.4 cites Andersen (1979) affirmatively while that work appears in no sources row and no Further reading list. `assessment`: the ten-item MCQ key is (b) nine times and (a)/(d) never, so the bank is defeatable without reading it - the key itself is correct, having been independently re-derived before the supplied answers were read. `accessibility`: all ten figure carriers emit no DOM at all, so no image and no alt text reaches the rendered page while the prose still points at them, and every MCQ renders as one run-on paragraph with no per-option structure. Disposition is escalate rather than revise because two print sources (hurst2009, brookfield2017), which ground seven sub-topic mappings, cannot be verified from this bundle at all: no source text is bound and no URL exists, so an author repair cycle cannot resolve them. The parent must bind source excerpts or record a standing limitation before `sources` can reach pass.

findings.message: specs/content/efmp-302/coverage/unit-03.md, row U3-08 ('Managing conflict while maintaining professionalism', topic-03.mdx) is grounded in goe2008. The retrieved full text of Goe, Bell & Little (2008) contains no conflict-management content: a search for de-escalat|conflict|angry|complaint|grievance returns 4 hits, all of which are a book title in the reference list and the Hamre & Pianta closeness/conflict/dependency relationship sub-scale. The four-decision-point de-escalation sequence taught in that section - the unit's most prescriptive content - therefore has no supporting source. REPAIR: either bind a source that actually supports conflict handling and cite it in the section, or re-map U3-08 and mark the sequence explicitly as practitioner guidance, as Topic 3.4 already does for its heuristic.

docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-03/topic-04.mdx line 78 ('### Non-verbal communication: its types and their classroom use') cites 'catalogued by Andersen (1979)' as the affirmative authority for the non-verbal immediacy channel set, but no andersen key exists in specs/content/efmp-302/sources/unit-03.md and no full reference appears in any topic's '## Further reading'. The work is real (Janis F. Andersen, 'Teacher Immediacy as a Predictor of Teaching Effectiveness', 1979) but a reader cannot locate it from the unit, and sources/unit-03.md asserts an invariant this breaks. REPAIR: add the sources row and the Further reading entry, or attribute the channel list to furlich2016/keelson2024 instead.

docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-03/unit-assessment.mdx '### Multiple-choice questions (MCQs)', items 1-10: the correct option is (b) on nine of ten items and (c) on the remaining one; (a) and (d) are never correct. The key was independently re-derived before the supplied answers were read and every item is correct and unambiguous, so this is a design defect rather than a keying error - but a candidate who answers (b) throughout scores 9/10 without reading a single stem, which destroys the section's validity. REPAIR: permute the option order so the key is distributed across a/b/c/d, updating '### MCQ answer key' to match.

hurst2009 (Hurst & Reding, Professionalism in Teaching, Pearson 2009) and brookfield2017 (Brookfield, Becoming a Critically Reflective Teacher, 2nd ed., Jossey-Bass) are recorded as '(print)' with no URL or DOI, and the prepared manifest binds no source text for them. Both were confirmed to be real published works via OpenLibrary, so these are not invented references, but the cited passages - Hurst & Reding's catalogue of daily professional-conduct markers (topic-02.mdx line 48) and Brookfield's mechanism of examining habitual practice against evidence (topic-02.mdx line 157, topic-05.mdx line 105) - could not be read and are unverified. These two keys carry the coverage mappings for U3-03, U3-04, U3-05, U3-06, U3-07, U3-11 and part of U3-13. This cannot be closed by an author repair: the parent must bind source excerpts into a new bundle or record a standing limitation.

specs/content/efmp-302/coverage/unit-03.md row U3-12 ('The teacher as change agent and as moral agent') is grounded in suarez2022, but docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-03/topic-05.mdx cites Suarez and McGrath only in the later '### The teacher as life-long learner' section (line 107); the change-agent/moral-agent section contains no citation at all. Suarez & McGrath's subject is teacher professional identity, which does not obviously support the change-agent material. Whether the mapping is wrong or the citation is merely missing from the section could not be settled from the abstract alone (OECD full text returned HTTP 403 to this host).

docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-03/topic-04.mdx line 117 states that Abekah Keelson and colleagues 'surveyed 614 university students in Ghana'. The 614 figure, the tertiary setting and the self-report Likert method are confirmed from the abstract (OpenAlex and DOAJ agree verbatim), but the abstract says only 'various Technical University education programs' and names no country; the full text returned HTTP 403 to this host. The Ghana attribution is well supported by author affiliations (all three authors at Takoradi Technical University, Sekondi-Takoradi, Ghana) but was not read in the source itself.

specs/content/efmp-302/content-spec.md '## Unit 3' > '**CLO/SLO refs**' records that the unit 'traces to guide CLOs 1, 5'. The course guide's Course Learning Outcomes are seven unnumbered bullets, of which the second - 'Identify and exhibit the characteristics and qualities of an effective teacher' - is the most direct match for this entire unit and is not in the trace. The unit content does cover it, so this is a G1 mapping gap rather than a content gap. Recorded, not repaired: the reviewer does not edit G1 artefacts.

MCQ 9 is genuinely Apply. The frontmatter blooms_summary claim of 'three at Apply' is numerically consistent but only one of the three holds up.

docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-03/unit-assessment.mdx frontmatter blooms_summary says 'ERQs at Analyze and Evaluate', but ERQ 4 is labelled (Create) and its rubric criterion is 'Design reasoning (Create)'. The content-spec blueprint permits 'Analyze to Evaluate/Create', so the item is in scope and only the frontmatter summary is narrower than the bank.
